verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents a real multi-part API surface: a Video API for avatar videos, translation and templates, plus Upload, Localization and Billing APIs, an Interactive Avatars API, completion webhooks and an MCP server. But nothing claims UI parity, and many UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent. Those include avatar creation from a photo, voice cloning, PPT-to-video, interactive quizzes and branching, collaboration and review, screen recording, AI roleplay, brand kits and SCORM export. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for avatar and voice creation, PPT/SOP-to-video, interactive and branching videos, roleplay and survey avatars, collaboration workflows, brand kit management, SCORM export, and any explicit UI-parity claim or independent confirmation.
